title: ItemRituals
description: Bring your crafting to life with ItemRituals
body:
# 🔮 Item Rituals

Tired of players instantly crafting game-breaking endgame gear with a single click? Want to add an immersive, high-stakes progression system to your survival or RPG server?

**Item Rituals** completely overhauls the crafting process for specific items of your choosing. Instead of instantly receiving an item from the crafting table, completing the recipe triggers an epic, immersive, server-wide world event. The ingredients are consumed, the ritual site is activated, and players must protect or witness the item materializing over time!

---

## ✨ Key Features

* **🔒 Crafting Interception:** Seamlessly stops items from being instantly crafted. It consumes the grid ingredients and initiates a physical ritual instead.
* **🌀 Sleek Magical Visuals:** Generates a massive, perfectly spaced 10x10 spinning ring of floating enchantment table glyph runes around the ritual site, complete with an expanding startup shockwave.
* **🔊 Immersive Audio:** Triggers the terrifying, spine-chilling **Warden Emergence roar** mixed with a physical Beacon activation blast on startup, followed by continuous ambient humming.
* **🧭 Dynamic BossBar HUD:** Every player in the world sees a countdown bar tracking the ritual. It includes a **smart directional arrow** (`⬆`, `↗`, `➡`, etc.) that updates in real-time to guide players directly to the ritual coordinates!
* **📦 In-Game GUI Manager:** No messy file editing required to add items. Manage your entire ritual registry via an interactive chest menu.
* **🛡️ Crash & Restart Proof:** Never worry about losing valuable items. If your server crashes, restarts, or reloads mid-ritual, the plugin instantly cancels the timer and safely drops the raw item onto the ground.
* **⚡ Smart NBT Tag Matching:** Features an advanced "loose-matching" engine. It cleanly bypasses invisible client-side tags (like creative mode trackers or repair costs) so survival-crafted items trigger perfectly every time.

---

## 🎮 How It Works (For Players)

1. **The Sacrifice:** A player places the ingredients for a registered item into a crafting table and clicks the output slot.
2. **The Awakening:** The crafting window closes. A loud Warden roar echoes through the area, a shockwave sweeps the floor, and a beautiful ring of spinning magical runes appears.
3. **The Manifestation:** The item floats dynamically in the center of the ring, glowing brightly and completely immune to fire, explosions, lava, or quick-fingered item thieves.
4. **The Reward:** Once the BossBar timer hits zero, a completion chime plays, and the fully materialized item drops safely onto the ground for the crafter to pick up!

---

## 🛠️ Admin Commands & Permissions

> 🔑 **Note:** All administrative commands require Operator (`OP`) status to execute.

### `/ir help`

Displays a clean, jargon-free guide explaining how to use the plugin. Perfect for quick day-to-day staff references.

### `/ir craft`

Registers the exact item you are currently holding in your main hand. From that moment forward, crafting that specific item type (matching its custom name/lore) will require a full ritual.

### `/ir remove`

Unregisters the item you are currently holding in your hand, restoring it back to a normal, instant craft.

### `/ir gui`

Opens a beautiful 54-slot visual inventory menu showing every item currently registered on your server.

* If no items are registered, a helpful barrier block prompt guides you on what to do.
* To delete an item from the ritual registry entirely, simply click on it inside the menu!

### `/ir reload`

Instantly reloads the internal database and `config.yml` setup from your disk. Tweak your settings on the fly without ever restarting or reloading the entire server!

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

The plugin automatically generates a clean config file where you can customize global parameters:

```yaml
# The length of time (in seconds) a ritual takes to materialize an item
ritual-duration: 30

# Internal storage handling registered items (Do not edit this section manually!)
ritual-items: []

```

---

## 💾 Installation Guide

1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the **Versions** tab.
2. Drop the file directly into your server's `plugins/` directory.
3. Restart your server to let the default configuration generate.
4. Log in, hold an item, type `/ir craft`, and watch the magic happen!
